meta.unit: Mormon speaks to the reader (3 Nephi 29–30)
principles: A commission stated before the message
Nine sins named in one sentence
An invitation with four consecutive results

world_behind.title: The chapter is two verses long
world_behind.text: It is the shortest chapter in 3 Nephi and closes the book. Jarom and Omni are the only other places in the volume where a whole unit runs this short, and both are custodial notes rather than an address.

world_behind.title: Verse 1 is the frame
world_behind.text: Mormon says he was commanded both to speak and to write these words.

world_behind.title: The speaker changes at the colon
world_behind.text: Verse 1 ends with "saying" and verse 2 is Christ speaking. Mormon does the same at 3 Nephi 29:1, opening in his own voice and handing over, so the book's last two chapters are a matched pair of relayed messages.

world_behind.title: The address is to the Gentiles
world_behind.text: Both verses name them, matching the audience of 3 Nephi 29.

world_behind.title: Nine sins are listed
world_behind.text: Verse 2 names lyings, deceivings, whoredoms, secret abominations, idolatries, murders, priestcrafts, envyings, and strifes. 3 Nephi 21:19 gives six of the same nine as the things that shall be done away, so the closing list is the reverse image of a promise made nine chapters earlier.

world_behind.title: The list overlaps two earlier ones
world_behind.text: 3 Nephi 16:10 and 21:19 both carry most of the same terms.

world_behind.title: The invitation ends in belonging
world_behind.text: Verse 2 closes with being numbered with his people who are of the house of Israel. 3 Nephi 16:13 and 3 Nephi 21:22 make the same offer in the same words, so the last sentence of the book repeats a term stated twice during the visit itself.

words.text: To listen with attention and act on what is heard. Treated at 1 Nephi 20:1. The record uses the word often, and verse 1 pairs it with "hear".
Acts of misleading. Treated at 3 Nephi 1:22. Five uses here against one in the King James Bible.
Things detestable to God. It appears seventy-five times in the record, and the King James Bible seventy-six. Verse 2 calls them secret, and names them again at the end of the list.
The worship of images or false gods. The record uses the word twice, here and at Ether 7:26, and the King James Bible once. Verse 2 places it in the middle of the list.
Setting oneself up as a light for gain. Treated at 2 Nephi 10:5. It runs through this record, with nothing matching it in the King James Bible.
Resentment at what others have. Treated at 2 Nephi 26:21. Its count is eight times in this book, while the King James Bible twice.
The cancelling of a debt or a charge. Treated at 2 Nephi 31:17. Verse 2 attaches it to baptism in his name.

phrases.term: Hearken, O ye Gentiles, and hear the words of Jesus Christ
phrases.text: Two verbs for the same act. The words are attributed before any of them are given.

phrases.term: The Son of the living God
phrases.text: The title Peter used at Caesarea Philippi (Matt. 16:16). It stands in the sentence introducing the speaker.

phrases.term: He commandeth me that I should write
phrases.text: Mormon on assignment. The chapter records the instruction alongside the message.

phrases.term: Turn, all ye Gentiles, from your wicked ways
phrases.text: The opening imperative. Turning comes before repenting in the order of the verse.
The first pair in the list. Both are sins of speech.

phrases.term: Of your whoredoms, and of your secret abominations, and your idolatries
phrases.text: Three that concern worship and the body. "Secret" is the only adjective in the list.

phrases.term: And of your murders, and your priestcrafts
phrases.text: Taking life and taking gain from religion, named together.

phrases.term: And your envyings, and your strifes
phrases.text: The two that are about other people. 3 Nephi 21:19 had said all of these would be done away.

phrases.term: And come unto me, and be baptized in my name
phrases.text: The turn from what to leave to where to go. The invitation is the second half of the verse.

phrases.term: That ye may receive a remission of your sins, and be filled with the Holy Ghost
phrases.text: Two results of the baptism. Acts 2:38 gives the same pair in the same order.

phrases.term: That ye may be numbered with my people who are of the house of Israel
phrases.text: The last clause of the book. What is offered is membership rather than favor.

verses.label: v. 1
verses.title: Two verses, and the first is a warrant
verses.text: Mormon does not speak here in his own person; he relays, and says so twice in one verse. Christ "hath commanded me that I should speak concerning you," and "he commandeth me that I should write." The chapter is two verses long and spends the first establishing that the second is not his.

verses.label: v. 2
verses.title: One sentence, ninety-two words
verses.text: The whole verse runs without a full stop: the sins on a single chain of and, then a catch-all, then the invitation in the same breath — come, be baptized, receive a remission, be filled, be numbered. The record does not let the reader out of the indictment before it offers the way out of it, because there is no punctuation between them.

chapter.title: The book ends with an invitation
chapter.text: Verse 2 closes 3 Nephi on terms rather than on narrative. The last words are about joining.

chapter.title: The commission is shown, not assumed
chapter.text: Verse 1 says Christ commanded both the speaking and the writing. Mormon puts his warrant on the page.

chapter.title: The Gentiles are addressed directly twice
chapter.text: Both verses name them. The chapter has one audience and says so.

chapter.title: Nine sins fit in a single line
chapter.text: Verse 2 runs them together without pause. The list is meant to be heard as a whole.

chapter.title: Only one item is called secret
chapter.text: Verse 2 attaches the word to abominations alone. Everything else in the list is public by nature.

chapter.title: Abominations appear twice
chapter.text: They are named as secret and then folded into the summary at the end. The repetition closes the list.

chapter.title: Four results follow one act
chapter.text: Verse 2 gives coming, baptism, remission, the Holy Ghost, and being numbered. Each depends on the one before.

chapter.title: The offer is membership
chapter.text: Verse 2 ends with being numbered among the house of Israel. 3 Nephi 21:22 had made the same offer in the same terms.

applications.title: Say who told you to speak
applications.text: Mormon names his commission before delivering the message. Where the words came from is part of the message.

applications.title: Notice what the account ends on
applications.text: Mormon closes the record of Christ's ministry with a direct address to the Gentiles rather than a summary of what happened. What a writer chooses to finish with tells you who he thinks the book is for.

applications.title: Turn before you sort
applications.text: The imperative comes first and the list follows. Direction changes before the inventory is finished.

applications.title: Read the whole list
applications.text: Nine items in a single line, none optional. It is easy to stop at the ones that are not yours.

applications.title: Count all three results
applications.text: The purpose clauses run: a remission of sins, being filled with the Holy Ghost, and being numbered with his people. Three things are promised here and it is easy to hear only the first.

applications.title: Take the offer as belonging, not status
applications.text: The last clause is being numbered with a people. The invitation ends in a group.

questions.text: Whose words am I passing on, and do I say so?
What wicked way am I being told to turn from?
Which of my sins are sins of speech?
What in my life is secret and would not survive daylight?
Where does my envy actually point?
What would a remission of sins change about tomorrow?
What people am I asking to be numbered with?

entries.head: 3 Ne. 21:6

anchor.quote: and come unto me, and be baptized in my name

entries.reason: the same terms offered to the Gentiles nine chapters earlier

targets.quote: that they may repent and come unto me and be baptized in my name
targets.verse_text: For thus it behooveth the Father that it should come forth from the Gentiles, that he may show forth his power unto the Gentiles, for this cause that the Gentiles, if they will not harden their hearts, that they may repent and come unto me and be baptized in my name and know of the true points of my doctrine, that they may be numbered among my people, O house of Israel;
targets.markdown: For thus it behooveth the Father that it should come forth from the Gentiles, that he may show forth his power unto the Gentiles, for this cause that the Gentiles, if they will not harden their hearts, **that they may repent and come unto me and be baptized in my name** and know of the true points of my doctrine, that they may be numbered among my people, O house of Israel;

entries.head: 3 Ne. 21:19

anchor.quote: and your envyings, and your strifes

entries.reason: the same six named as things to be done away

targets.quote: all lyings, and deceivings, and envyings, and strifes, and priestcrafts, and whoredoms, shall be done away.
targets.verse_text: And it shall come to pass that all lyings, and deceivings, and envyings, and strifes, and priestcrafts, and whoredoms, shall be done away.
targets.markdown: And it shall come to pass that **all lyings, and deceivings, and envyings, and strifes, and priestcrafts, and whoredoms, shall be done away**.

entries.head: 3 Ne. 16:10

anchor.quote: and of your whoredoms, and of your secret abominations

entries.reason: the Father's list of what would end the fulness

targets.quote: and murders, and priestcrafts, and whoredoms, and of secret abominations;
targets.verse_text: And thus commandeth the Father that I should say unto you: At that day when the Gentiles shall sin against my gospel, and shall reject the fulness of my gospel, and shall be lifted up in the pride of their hearts above all nations, and above all the people of the whole earth, and shall be filled with all manner of lyings, and of deceits, and of mischiefs, and all manner of hypocrisy, and murders, and priestcrafts, and whoredoms, and of secret abominations; and if they shall do all those things, and shall reject the fulness of my gospel, behold, saith the Father, I will bring the fulness of my gospel from among them.
targets.markdown: And thus commandeth the Father that I should say unto you: At that day when the Gentiles shall sin against my gospel, and shall reject the fulness of my gospel, and shall be lifted up in the pride of their hearts above all nations, and above all the people of the whole earth, and shall be filled with all manner of lyings, and of deceits, and of mischiefs, and all manner of hypocrisy, **and murders, and priestcrafts, and whoredoms, and of secret abominations**; and if they shall do all those things, and shall reject the fulness of my gospel, behold, saith the Father, I will bring the fulness of my gospel from among them.

entries.head: 3 Ne. 21:22

anchor.quote: that ye may be numbered with my people who are of the house of Israel

entries.reason: the same promise of being numbered with the remnant

targets.quote: they shall come in unto the covenant and be numbered among this the remnant of Jacob,
targets.verse_text: But if they will repent and hearken unto my words, and harden not their hearts, I will establish my church among them, and they shall come in unto the covenant and be numbered among this the remnant of Jacob, unto whom I have given this land for their inheritance;
targets.markdown: But if they will repent and hearken unto my words, and harden not their hearts, I will establish my church among them, and **they shall come in unto the covenant and be numbered among this the remnant of Jacob**, unto whom I have given this land for their inheritance;

entries.head: 2 Ne. 30:2

anchor.quote: Turn, all ye Gentiles, from your wicked ways

entries.reason: Nephi stating the same condition for Gentile and Jew alike

targets.quote: as many of the Gentiles as will repent are the covenant people of the Lord;
targets.verse_text: For behold, I say unto you that as many of the Gentiles as will repent are the covenant people of the Lord; and as many of the Jews as will not repent shall be cast off; for the Lord covenanteth with none save it be with them that repent and believe in his Son, who is the Holy One of Israel.
targets.markdown: For behold, I say unto you that **as many of the Gentiles as will repent are the covenant people of the Lord**; and as many of the Jews as will not repent shall be cast off; for the Lord covenanteth with none save it be with them that repent and believe in his Son, who is the Holy One of Israel.

entries.head: Ether 7:26
entries.reason: the only other use of the word in the record

targets.quote: because the people did repent of their iniquities and idolatries

targets.markdown: And **because the people did repent of their iniquities and idolatries** the Lord did spare them, and they began to prosper again in the land. And it came to pass that Shule begat sons and daughters in his old age.

entries.head: Moro. 8:25

entries.reason: the sequence Mormon later set out to Moroni

targets.markdown: And the first fruits of repentance is baptism; and baptism cometh by faith unto the fulfilling the commandments; and **the fulfilling the commandments bringeth remission of sins**;

entries.head: Acts 2:38

anchor.quote: and be filled with the Holy Ghost

entries.reason: the same two results named at Pentecost

targets.verse_text: Then Peter said unto them, Repent, and be baptized every one of you in the name of Jesus Christ for the remission of sins, and ye shall receive the gift of the Holy Ghost.
targets.markdown: Then Peter said unto them, Repent, and be baptized every one of you in the name of Jesus Christ **for the remission of sins, and ye shall receive the gift of the Holy Ghost**.

entries.reason: Peter's confession, in the same words

targets.markdown: And Simon Peter answered and said, **Thou art the Christ, the Son of the living God**.
